title: Implement canonical serialization for article and log entry types
description:
Implement deterministic serialization for Article and group log entries to bytes. The canonical form is the input to both CID computation and ed25519 signing. Artifact: src/canonical.rs in usenet-ipfs-core. Must be deterministic: same logical value always produces identical bytes regardless of field insertion order.

Acceptance:
- canonical_bytes(article: &Article) -> Vec<u8> is deterministic
- canonical_bytes for log entries is deterministic
- Round-trip test: parse -> serialize -> parse produces equal value
- Cross-validated against at least one reference implementation (Python or Go) using a known test vector
